# Der Reiskoch

> German food blog about Asian cuisine (primarily Thai), by Jens Ihrig.
> The German version is available at https://www.der-reiskoch.de/

Content covers recipes, ingredient guides, know-how articles, a culinary diary, and Thai food festival listings. Regional cuisines include Thai, Burmese, Khmer, Shan, and broader Southeast and East Asian cooking.

## Sections

- [Recipes](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/recipes/): Asian recipes from all over the world
- [Pantry](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/pantry/): Essential Asian ingredients
- [Alphabetical List of Asian Ingredients](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/pantry/ingredient-list-a-z/): Full A–Z ingredient index
- [Asian Kitchen Know-How](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/know-how/): Articles and guides about Asian cooking
- [Foodie Diary](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/diary/): Monthly diary of food discoveries and restaurant visits
- [Thai Food Festival Calendar](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/calendar/): Calendar of Thai food events

## Key Articles

- [Ahaan Thai Food Dictionary](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/know-how/thai-food-dictionary/): Thai food dictionary with transliterations
- [Thai Food Festivals 2026](https://en.der-reiskoch.de/calendar/thai-food-festivals-2026/): Current Thai food festival listings
